title: BlockDefIr
description: A Bedrock block definition. SC-150. Storage and slot binding are SC-120 section 6 and are not represented here — the IR describes the add-on, not the world.

states.description: Declaration order is NORMATIVE — it determines the mixed-radix index encoding in SC-120 section 6.1, which is written into chunk storage. Reordering states is schema drift.

traits.description: Engine-provided automatic states, expanded into states before encoding and appended in the fixed order placement_direction, placement_position.

components.description: The base component set. Keys are Bedrock component names; unrecognised ones are preserved here AND listed in unknown, because a later version may implement them.

permutations.description: ORDERED. Later entries override earlier ones per component key. Conditions may only reference block state and property queries plus pure maths — no entity or world context — which is what allows pre-resolution per state index at bind time (SC-150 section 1).

vanillaFallback.description: The wire carrier, computed at translation time from material_instances colours and map_color. SC-270 section 4. Must exist in every supported protocol version.

name.description: Namespaced, as Bedrock writes it, e.g. 'wizardry:charge'.

values.description: AT MOST 16 — Bedrock's hard cap. The {min, max} shorthand is expanded here. Value order is normative for the same reason declaration order is.
